verdict.rationale: Missive's own rules engine supports time-based, multi-step automations: rules can run in steps over time, wait on calendar or business-hour delays, and then act, such as escalating unanswered emails at 24/48/72 hours. These delays are per-conversation sequences triggered by events, not a recurring schedule. Missing for 10: a documented recurring or cron-style scheduler for jobs or workflows, scheduled runs independent of a conversation trigger, AI- or agent-driven scheduled jobs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Rules can now run in steps over time. Each step waits, checks its own conditions, then acts on the same conversation.
Escalate unanswered support emails: label at 24 hrs, notify the lead at 48, reassign at 72.
Delays can count calendar time or business hours.
